claim: Draft and execute per-collection id renumbering plans for the codepath: and cb-okf: collections, whose a/c serial ranges collide (codepath:a001-a004 vs c001-c005; cb-okf:a001-a013 vs c001-c002), so the pure letter-swap cannot apply. Shape: keep a-side serials through the letter-swap (aNNN -> bNNN), renumber the c-side past the collection's max serial, and sweep every reference in the same pass - in-repo cross-references included (the cb: graph's codepath:c005 exemplar, docs/guide/4-code.md, skills/present-codepath, lib/cb/codepath.ex docs, tests) - because renumbered ids get no alias: a stale reference letter-swaps to the wrong node, which is worse than not found. Until discharged, both collections stay on legacy ids, which remain fully valid.

evidence.detail: Deferred from the cb-id-b-migration (PR #10) when the serial collision was discovered; the same collision pattern forced the cb:a566 -> cb:b572 renumber during the merge of main's concurrent mints. Materialized as a desk obligation on operator instruction.
